name: Ordered Notes
desc: Notes with matching handwriting that have been painstakingly arranged in chronological order. These appear to chronicle a certain person's "adventures" in this place.

desc.text:
<color=#ffffffa6>As luck would have it, a previously unrecorded ruin came upon me by chance. This is proof positive that my efforts to overcome the relentless obstructions of the Mahamata have all been worth it.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The Akademiya's aversion to the desert has grown to comedic proportions. The unknown is our playground while Akasha shackles us. And those who hide behind shackles, what is it exactly that they fear?</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>I won't be leaving this place anytime soon. I've discovered a number of sites worth exploring, and it would be remiss of me not to seize this opportunity.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>It won't be easy to tell day from night, since I'm cut off from the outside world. If I'm to avoid losing myself in the unknown, I must not forget to mark the passage of time.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Recorded on the morning of the tenth of May.</color>

<color=#ffffffa6>That "senior scholar" fell and hurt himself. Typical of someone from the Rtawahist — always gazing skyward and never at their feet. I'm guessing the Obscuring Cell must've been one of King Deshret's prized creations, judging by how many of them there are around here.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Thankfully, the injury was limited to a few scrapes and a mild dislocation. After I popped the bone back into place, I had him lie down and rest. This whole thing will set us back a while, but perhaps that's not such a bad thing. For those like him who lack the skills, doing nothing might be the best contribution they can make.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>As I was treating him, he brought up that tired old topic, asking me to join the Darshan. Once more, I firmly refused. Mediocre students find safety in confining themselves to a single field. But what good would that do me?</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>It's only been a few days, but I've already made significant progress. There are numerous writings here about the Seven Pillars, each one captivating and exciting in its depth and detail.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Now that the senior is no longer holding me back, I can finally work at a faster pace.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Recorded on the morning of the thirteenth of May.</color>

<color=#ffffffa6>The appearance of the Ibis King was a pleasant surprise, though not as pleasant as one might expect.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>He's a skilled storyteller, but he loses steam once it's clear his listeners aren't fooled. That said, there are elements of his tales worth investigating and verifying.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Although he did point out the exit route, in his current state, he can't really intervene. And I can tell he's putting on a front and isn't all that friendly toward me. But that's typical of people who care about their status. Since I need a bit more time — given how big this place is — I suppose we'll have to put up with each other a little while longer.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Besides, isn't mutual dislike a positive emotion in those who can't get along?</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>In addition, saving that senior was definitely the correct decision.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Oh, I nearly forgot: recorded at noon on the sixteenth of May.</color>

<color=#ffffffa6>My supplies have run out. Unless I wish to die here, I will have to leave this place.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>But I still refuse to accept anything from Thoth. People like him, who only talk benefits and never mention the cost, are a dime a dozen at the Grand Bazaar.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Of course, for anyone after me who falls for the temptations he offers, remember this at least: do not trust the Ibis King.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Recorded on the final day — Zandik.</color>

value.name: Ragged Notes
value.desc: Notes salvaged from all over the ruins. Based on the state of the fragile, yellowed paper, they appear to have endured the passage of many, many years.
